user_scenario: You are Walter Yarrow, 66, a retired ferry mechanic in Magnolia, Seattle, calling Kestrel Pharmacy on a Wednesday morning. You are friendly but blunt, you like to know what you are paying for, and you get to the point. You have had the monthly Delivery Pass for about a year and a half, your blood-sugar and blood-pressure pills come to the house, and you use rush deliveries more than you expected. You have decided you want to switch to the annual Delivery Pass starting today, because paying month by month has started to feel silly, and you are ready to buy it now. You want the switch itself done in this call, on the same plan and address; you are not asking to cancel anything. When the agent asks who you are, you give your phone number, 2065550583, and your date of birth, 1960-05-29; you give your email, walter.yarrow@outlook.com, or your home ZIP code, 98199, only if the agent wants one more detail. If the agent asks, deliveries still go to 3306 W Barrett St, and you want the annual pass to start today. If the agent asks whether you ever had a free trial, you say you had the thirty free days when you first signed up for the monthly pass. You do not bring up any other order. If the agent mentions the rush order you cancelled on Sunday morning, you say that is right, you cancelled it yourself within a few minutes because you decided to drive over and pick up the pills instead, and if the agent says a refund for it has to be put through first, you tell them to go ahead. When the agent hands the annual pass purchase over to you, you make it yourself with exactly the plan, start date and amount the agent gives you, and you tell the agent it went through. You take the agent's word on the amounts - you have no statement in front of you - and you do not ask for anything else. Once the agent confirms you are now on the annual Delivery Pass, you thank them and hang up.

WORKLOG / DOSSIER - delivery_and_pickup task 1 (Walter Yarrow, Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly, frozen 2026-09-23 10:40 EDT)

[Step 0 - draw] `draw_counts.py ... --task 1` printed {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4]}: a root plus exactly 1 prerequisite problem, >= 1 value_input edge, factor counts 6 (annual pass switch charge) and 4 (dispatch-cancellation refund).

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: delivery_ext_overdue_cycle_settlement, delivery_ext_express_order_fee, delivery_ext_late_delivery_refund and tools settle_overdue_pass_fee_c99b5804, charge_order_fee_01b49350, refund_late_delivery_fee_e6f66314. Claimed here (disjoint): delivery_ext_dispatch_cancellation_refund (refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af, agent) and delivery_ext_annual_pass_switch_charge (switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026, owner=user). This is the last task; after it every extended policy is claimed exactly once, and no policy or tool is left idle.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: "switch my monthly Delivery Pass to the annual one, starting today, and buy it now". Core scored value: the switch charge 27.92 the patient pays himself. Hidden hop: the switch charge is fixed only after every order cancelled before dispatch carries a refund entry for its fee; the Sunday 2026-09-20 express order he cancelled still has its 6.29 fee unrefunded, so the agent must first work out and book the cancellation refund (4.60), which lowers the recent-fees credit base. Breadth: cycle dates and plan age (unused-cycle credit method), one-month fee and refund ledger, 3-month completions / failed attempts / order values, rewards level, coverage class (cross-difficulty coverage), rx refills and home-delivery pickups (cross-difficulty rx), 6-month cancellation history.

[Problem-tree card] Root delivery_ext_annual_pass_switch_charge (on_request, owner=user). Edge: annual_pass_switch_charge -> dispatch_cancellation_refund, kind value_input, gate net_recent_fees, form state, sentence (affirmative): "The switch charge for the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is fixed only after every order of the plan cancelled before dispatch carries a refund entry for each fee charged on it." Condition: every fee on an order with a cancellation entry has a refund entry naming it. Resolved by refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af (agent). False at opening: delivery_orders cancellation row of 2026-09-20 (cancel_reason patient_request) + delivery_charges express fee 6.29 on that order + no delivery_fee_refunded row anywhere on the plan. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a refund against a cancelled order's fee (the late-delivery refund applies to delivered late orders; the other writes book charges). Four-point test: connective "only after"; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (refund entries on cancelled orders' fees); no tool/id/code token; strength "only after ... every ... each" = the closed set of fees on cancelled orders. The charter now carries both directions: this sentence and the late-refund sentence are affirmative ("is fixed/worked out only after"), the express-fee sentence is negated ("is not fixed until"), each in the voice that line of business uses for that result.
Derivation: sentence + ledger (fee 6.29 on the cancelled 09-20 order, no refund) + the cancellation-refund rule (a fee on an order cancelled before dispatch is refunded as a cancellation refund) -> book that refund first. Order: refund -> switch. Deletion sensitivity (evalx): skipping the refund gives a switch charge of 23.32 instead of 27.92. user_scenario never names the cancelled order's refund on its own initiative ("You do not bring up any other order"); the tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Step 11 refund - subject delivery_fee_refunded, governing delivery_evt_refunds: refund_once (the 6.29 fee has no refund; source_charge_id field on it is empty); lost_claim_window (scheduled 2026-09-20 + 7 calendar days = 2026-09-27 >= 2026-09-23, inclusive; 2026-09-28 fails); trace_complete (scheduled Sunday 2026-09-20 day 0, Monday business day 1, Tuesday 2026-09-22 business day 2 <= frozen). Base "an order already dispatched cannot be cancelled" holds: the order has no attempt or completion entry. Step 13 switch - subjects delivery_plan_details_updated (delivery_plan_enrollment: switch allowed because the Monthly pass's plan_switch_allowed is true and the plan is active; he had a trial - trial_end_date 2025-03-07 after opened 2025-02-05 - so billing starts on the switch date with no new trial; no structured gate applies to details_updated, hence policy_scope) and delivery_subscription_charged (delivery_evt_subscription_billing one_charge_per_cycle: no subscription entry with cycle_start_date 2026-09-23 exists; the switch date is today's date, also the date stamped on the step-11 refund).

[Business-object card] Plan 7257ce18 (Monthly). Refund object: the 2026-09-20 express order e43da606 and its fee a038a2e5 (correlation source_order_id / source_charge_id). Excluded: the 2026-09-15 express fee (delivered order), the 2026-07-24 same-day order cancelled 2026-07-25 (no fee on a Monthly pass - it only counts toward the repeat-cancellation tier). Switch object: the same plan record; its current cycle 2026-09-07..2026-10-06 supplies the unused days; the 19 monthly subscription entries settle earlier cycles.

[Factor card - evalx handling-time figures]
Dispatch-cancellation refund (baseline "An order cancelled before dispatch has its speed fee refunded in full, rounded to the cent." = 6.29): packing_charge (multi-source: patient_request AND same day) 1.00 (baseline -> 5.35); repeat_cancellation_charge 2 cancellations at his request in 6 months -> 0.75 (-> 5.16); restocking_charge value 96.40 -> 0.50 (-> 4.97); rewards_retained_adjustment (method) Gold -> 75% rounded up: 2.25 -> 1.69 (-> 4.04). Result 6.29 - 1.69 = 4.60. Near-miss: the July cancellation was on a later day than placed (2.00 packing then) - it belongs to a different order and only counts toward the repeat tier.
Annual pass switch charge (baseline "The switch into the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is charged the annual switch price, annual_switch_price_usd, less a recent-fees credit of standard_credit_pct percent of the order fees charged on the plan in the month up to the switch date net of the refunds booked on the plan in that month, that net amount never below zero, rounded to the cent." = 48.00 - 50% x 7.98 = 44.01): unused_cycle_credit (method) 19 whole months -> daily 5.99 x 13/30 = 2.60 (weekly tier would give 1.40; baseline none -> 30.52); recent_fees_credit_share (multi-source: Gold AND 9 completions >= 6) 100% of 7.98 (baseline 50% -> 31.91); medicare_member_credit (cross-difficulty coverage) Medicare Advantage -> 3.00 (-> 30.92); maintenance_delivery_credit (cross-difficulty rx, multi-source) 12 refills and 4 home-delivery pickups -> 4.00 (-> 31.92); missed_delivery_credit 1 failed attempt (2026-08-05 building_access) -> 1.00 (-> 28.92); delivery_spend_credit 631.85 of orders placed incl. the two cancelled ones -> 1.50 (-> 29.42). Near-miss: counting only delivered orders gives 477.35 and the lower 0.75 tier; the rule says cancelled orders included. Result 48.00 - 2.60 - 7.98 - 3.00 - 4.00 - 1.00 - 1.50 = 27.92.
Declared overrides: refunds "An order cancelled before dispatch has its order fees refunded in full where order_cancel_refund_before_dispatch is true"; subscription billing "a plan ... is charged that fee ..." (the switch charge is not the plain fee). Inherited: refund once / never more than charged, the lost-package windows, the switch rules of delivery_plan_enrollment, one charge per cycle.

[Seed rationale] customers/stores: identity and store 05318 (FK parents). delivery_plans: active Monthly, opened 2025-02-05 (19 months), trial to 2025-03-07, cycle 2026-09-07..2026-10-06, fees_net_usd 126.39 = 19 x 5.99 + 2 x 6.29. delivery_charges: 19 subscription entries, express fees of 09-15 and 09-20 (each 6.99 less the 10 percent maintenance discount he earned then - 4 home-delivery pickups, >= 3 refills - no supplement), no refund. delivery_orders: 11 orders since 2026-06-26 with completions (9 inside 3 months), the 08-05 failed attempt then delivered on time, the July same-day order booked for 07-25 and cancelled that morning, the 09-20 express order cancelled at his request. rx: metformin and lisinopril monthly refills, 4 released by home delivery on delivery-order days. coverage_plans: Medicare Advantage active. rewards: Gold active. Automatic clauses: renewal already charged 2026-09-07; no late order owes a refund; allowance respected (2 free express per month, the third charged).

[Persona design] Walter, blunt and friendly, states the goal (annual pass from today, buying it now, same plan and address, no cancellation), gives phone 2065550583 and DOB 1960-05-29 when asked, email/ZIP only if more is needed, answers address/start-date/trial questions, confirms the Sunday cancellation only if the agent raises it and lets the agent refund it, makes the purchase himself with the plan, date and amount the agent gives, and closes once told he is on the annual pass. He knows no amounts.

[Standard solution] locate -> verify -> read plan, orders, charges, store, coverage, rewards, prescriptions, fills -> unlock + refund_cancelled_order_fee_665693af(plan, fee a038a2e5, order e43da606, 4.60) -> unlock (user) + switch_delivery_pass_b46d5026(plan, Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual, 2026-09-23, 27.92) run by the patient.

[Verification] evalx: refund result=4.6 (factor baselines 5.35 / 5.16 / 4.97 / 4.04, all 6.29); switch result=27.92 (30.52 / 31.91 / 30.92 / 31.92 / 28.92 / 29.42, all 44.01); with the refund skipped the switch recomputes to 23.32. Revision: the tool docstrings were reworded to drop ordering words (start date / opening cycle instead of first); missed-delivery threshold moved from a literal into params (missed_low_count); the prerequisite sentence was renamed to "The switch charge for the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual ..." in rule, policy_source and compute_basis together; the late-refund rewards ladder was renamed to "late-delivery refund" so it cannot be confused with the retained-charge adjustment of this task. Per-task gates: check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (closure 79 = 79); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK (2 calls, 5 base gates, 45 seed rows); check_compute COMPUTE OK (10 factors, 2 cross-difficulty, 28 history rows, 28 branches); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK.

[Manual gates] Customer's own write: buying the annual pass is his purchase with his own card, done on the spot. No real-world wait: the cancellation happened before the call, refund and switch are synchronous. Time anchors: switch date = frozen date; unused days exclude the switch date and include 2026-10-06; claim/trace windows from the scheduled date. Draft recomputation from visible context: the switch rule sends the reader to cancelled orders' refunds; the ledger shows the 09-20 fee unrefunded; the cancellation-refund rule gives 4.60; the switch rule then gives 27.92 - identical to gold; no second reading found (the July cancellation has no fee to refund).

[Difficulty-level closing] Union of scopes = {overdue_cycle_settlement, express_order_fee, late_delivery_refund} (task 0) + {dispatch_cancellation_refund, annual_pass_switch_charge} (task 1) = all 5 extended policies, pairwise disjoint; 5 task tools, each named by exactly one policy's target_tool and each called by exactly one task; both tasks call an owner=user tool; no handoff in any gold.

[Round 2 revision log - audit env/env_0021_retail_pharmacy_chain/audits/policy_task/delivery_and_pickup/ (1.md, _difficulty.md)]
- T1-1 / D-F1 symptom: the switch's baseline paragraph gave 48.00 (no recent-fees credit) while the fall-through of recent_fees_credit_share is the standard 50 percent share (all factor baselines -> 44.01). Root cause: the standard share lived only in the ladder. Change: the baseline sentence of the switch rule now reads "The switch into the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is charged the annual switch price, annual_switch_price_usd, less a recent-fees credit of standard_credit_pct percent of the order fees charged on the plan in the month up to the switch date net of the refunds booked on the plan in that month, that net amount never below zero, rounded to the cent."; baseline.params = [annual_switch_price_usd, standard_credit_pct]; compute_basis.switch_price quotes it. Re-run: baseline paragraph alone = 48.00 - 3.99 = 44.01 = computations.baseline_result; factor figures unchanged (30.52 / 31.91 / 30.92 / 31.92 / 28.92 / 29.42).
- D-P4: the recent-fees sentence now states the floor ("that net amount never below zero") and compute_basis.net_recent_fees quotes it instead of the prerequisite sentence; inactive on this world (12.58 > 4.60).
- D-P3(b): the cancellation refund now works on the cancelled order's speed fee only (compute filters fee_type by the order's speed; a distance or redelivery fee on a cancelled order is refunded in full outside this computation); rule, baseline ("An order cancelled before dispatch has its speed fee refunded in full, rounded to the cent.") and overwrite replaced_by rewritten together. The 09-20 order's speed fee is its 6.29 express fee, so 4.60 is unchanged.
- D-X3: the Medicare member credit reads the primary insurance record in active status (compute CFIELD(..., coverage_order='primary')); Walter's only record is primary and active, so 3.00 is unchanged.
- T1-2 (observation): find_stores and find_rx_prescriptions kept as foreign-key parents needed by the replay closure; their necessity text now says plainly that they decide no scored value.
- Re-run: refund 4.60 (5.35 / 5.16 / 4.97 / 4.04, all 6.29); switch 27.92 (all baselines 44.01); skipping the refund gives 23.32. Full gate block green.

[Round 3 revision log - audit revision_2 (_difficulty.md, 1.md)]
- R2-P1 symptom: the settlement rule's round-2 sentence "A cycle that is not overdue is charged the plan's subscription fee ..." also covered the annual pass's opening cycle on a switch, giving 48.00 against the switch charge 27.92. Root cause: the D-O1 repair restated the superseded base clause without excepting the cycle the switch policy prices. Change (delivery.extended.yaml, delivery_ext_overdue_cycle_settlement.rule, first sentence): "A cycle that is neither overdue nor the opening cycle of a switch into the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is charged the plan's subscription fee, on activation for the plan's first cycle and on the cycle's first day for every later cycle; the opening cycle of a switch into the Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual is charged the switch charge that the switch rules set for it, and an overdue cycle is settled as follows." The switch amount's argument_uniqueness_tracing now cites this sentence to exclude the 48.00 reading. Re-run: 4.60 / 27.92 unchanged.
- R2-X2: the switch policy's coverage cross_category note now reads "primary prescription insurance record in active status", matching rule and compute.
- R2-X1 (express fee, task 0's policy): see task 0's round-3 log; no effect on this world.
